Read an example dataset shipped with rebelrebel

Source: R/example.R
rr_example.Rd

rebelrebel's example data are parquet files in its extdata folder, opened lazily as DuckDB tables; collect one with dplyr::collect(). Each dataset has its own help page (?dansk, ?dansk_relief, ...): what a row is, its columns, its sources and its licence. The same is in the folder's data dictionary, data-dict.yaml (https://data-dict.tidyverse.org/), and in each file's own parquet metadata, so a file copied out of the package still says what it is. The sources are BibTeX entries in the package's REFERENCES.bib. The files were made by the R package ramb, whose data-raw folder holds the scripts.

Usage

rr_example(name = NULL, con = NULL)

Arguments

name

The dataset's name; NULL for the catalogue of all of them.

con

A DuckDB connection to open the dataset on; rebelrebel's own by default. Lazy tables used together must share a connection, so give the one your other tables are on (dbplyr::remote_con() of one of them).

Value

A lazy DuckDB table; or, for name = NULL, a tibble with one row per dataset: name, label, description, rows, licence, cite (its sources as text) and bibtex (the same as BibTeX), read from the files' own metadata.

Details

The two datasets with shapes (dansk_harbours, trawlsurveytows) hold them in geometry as DuckDB's GEOMETRY (GeoParquet, longitude and latitude on WGS 84), which DuckDB's ST_ functions work on. Collected into R it is WKB; for sf: x <- dplyr::collect(rr_example("dansk_harbours")), then sf::st_sf(x[names(x) != "geometry"], geometry = sf::st_as_sfc(structure(x$geometry, class = "WKB"), crs = 4326)).

Examples

rr_example()
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpqTczC4/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
#> # A tibble: 5 × 7
#>   name            label                  description   rows licence cite  bibtex
#>   <chr>           <chr>                  <chr>        <int> <chr>   <chr> <chr> 
#> 1 dansk           Danish vessel tracks … Each row i… 395558 MIT, C… "ICE… "@Tec…
#> 2 dansk_harbours  Harbour polygons for … Each row i…    942 MIT, C… "ICE… "@Tec…
#> 3 dansk_relief    Seabed and land eleva… Each row i… 604800 Public… "NOA… "@Mis…
#> 4 trawlsurvey     Icelandic groundfish … Each row i…   8918 MFRI d… "Mar… "@Mis…
#> 5 trawlsurveytows Icelandic groundfish … Each row i…    581 MFRI d… "Mar… "@Mis…
rr_example("dansk_harbours")
